record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: HISUI_SLIGGOO (2 stars) and HISUI_GOODRA (3 stars), maxPP 100, range 1, declare SHELTER (passive NONE in the catalog; both are regional units).
record.summary: Self defense buff, no damage. The caster gains raw 3/6/12/24 DEF by caster stars (6 for HISUI_SLIGGOO at 2 stars, 12 for HISUI_GOODRA at 3 stars), passed through addDefense with apBoost 1 and the cast crit flag: requested = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit else 1)); then Big Eater Belt (x1.25, rounded down, positive value) is applied and Twist Band does nothing to a positive value; DEF cannot go below 0. The change is fight-only (permanent is not passed). Afterwards a SMOKE board effect is added at the cell given by pokemon.targetX / targetY (the coordinates of the caster's current target, not the caster's own cell), which puts the SMOKE effect on whoever stands there (unless that entity holds Heavy-Duty Boots) and, the first time, broadcasts a client animation. A reader of the SMOKE effect that changes combat was not found in app/core, app/types or app/config; the only reader found is the client animation.

targeting.who: the caster itself (DEF gain); the SMOKE board effect lands on the cell of the caster's current target
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the inherited default true, so a target in range is needed to start the cast. The cast target argument is unused; the smoke cell uses pokemon.targetX / targetY, which setTarget sets to the target's position, or to -1 when there is none. If the coordinates were -1 the board index would not exist; whether that can happen at cast time was not examined.

geometry.shape: self, plus one board cell (the caster's target's cell at cast time) for the SMOKE effect

effects.scaling: requested = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if the cast crit, else 1)); apBoost 1 and the cast's crit flag are passed, so AP and crit both scale it (crit only if the cast crit, which needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied = requested after Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down, the value is positive) and Twist Band (no effect on a positive value; self-cast anyway), added to current DEF with a floor of 0. Fight-only. Shared helper rules: knowledge core-mechanics section I / J.

Board.addBoardEffect adds EffectEnum.SMOKE to the entity currently on that cell unless it holds Heavy-Duty Boots, records it on the cell the first time (later calls on the same cell do not re-broadcast), and board.setEntityOnCell moves effects with entities (lost on leaving a cell that has the effect, gained on entering one unless IMMUNITY_BOARD_EFFECTS). A combat reader of the SMOKE effect was not found in app/core, app/types or app/config; the client animation is the only reader found.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 1-star and 4-star values (3, 24) are not reachable by these units' bare star counts.

record.positionalConditions: The smoke cell is the caster's target's cell at cast time; nothing else is positional.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast adds DEF again (accumulating, subject to the DEF floor); the SMOKE effect on a cell is a set, so it does not stack.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw DEF 3/6/12/24 by caster stars (6 for HISUI_SLIGGOO, 12 for HISUI_GOODRA). Requested = round(raw x (1 + AP/100) x crit factor); applied = requested x1.25 rounded down with Big Eater Belt, otherwise unchanged, then limited by DEF >= 0. Unlike most self-buffs here, AP and crit do scale this one (apBoost 1).
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: What the SMOKE effect does on an entity in combat (no combat reader found in app/core, app/types or app/config; the client reader is only an animation)
